title: Political life of Clint Eastwood - Wikipedia
snippet: During the 2008 United States Presidential Election, Eastwood stated that he would be voting for John McCain for president; he had known McCain since 1973.  Upon the election of Barack Obama, Eastwood stated "Obama is my president now and I am going to be wishing him the very best because it is what is best for all of us."  On August 4, 2012, Eastwood endorsed former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney.
